cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our team.
The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 8 years of QA experience driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and Multi-tenant software applications.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Excellent team player, adaptable to an evolving startup environment.

cond_0129.intro:
The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0129.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.
cond_0129.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 8 years of QA experience across strategy, test execution, and automation, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Some background in testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Working knowledge of SaaS and multi-tenant software application testing.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Exposure to analytical problem-solving within complex hardware/software systems — the ability to identify and surface issues develops with time and practice.
Comfort working collaboratively in a team and openness to adapting as priorities shift.
An interest in [Company name masked]'s mission around energy equality and technological innovation.

The role is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be central to enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. You will regularly connect with engineers, product managers, field service teams, and partners to keep quality efforts aligned across the organisation. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, actively contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — staying in close contact with engineers across the organisation, product management, field service and partners, and speaking up early when issues arise.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results, and walk stakeholders through findings as needed.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team, coordinating regularly with the team throughout the process.
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field; Advanced degree preferred.
At least 8 years of QA experience driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and Multi-tenant software applications.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Excellent team player, adaptable to an evolving startup environment.
Commitment to [Company name masked]'s mission of energy equality and technological innovation.
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0195.values: We value having a positive impact on the people our work affects. We aim to act with responsibility, fairness, and respect in the way we make decisions and deliver our work.

cond_0251.intro:
The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you will lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in driving the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, owning test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Take full ownership of the lab, planning and building new test systems as the situation demands.
Determine what's important to test and troubleshoot — leading coordination with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures, directing support from the R&D team.
cond_0251.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field; Advanced degree preferred.
At least 8 years of QA experience driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and Multi-tenant software applications.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Excellent team player, adaptable to an evolving startup environment.
Commitment to [Company name masked]'s mission of energy equality and technological innovation.

cond_0261.intro:
The Senior QA Engineer works alongside the team to build and deliver our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would coordinate quality practices and testing efforts across the entire end-to-end stack of our platform, including hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform supports the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will help enable the quality process around building our products and support the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position calls for a combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Work hands-on alongside the team, using diagnostics, code/architecture review, and lab experimentation to help ensure products perform reliably and consistently.
Coordinate with the team to plan and build out new test systems in the lab as the situation demands.
Work with engineers across the organization, product management, field service, and partners to align on what's important to test and troubleshoot.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware, covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans and cases, and maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases, and results.
Work with the R&D team to define and build manual and automated test fixtures.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field.
At least 8 years of QA experience covering QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and multi-tenant software applications.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Strong team player, adaptable to an evolving startup environment.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.

cond_0281.intro:
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our team.
The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0281.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.
cond_0281.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 8 years of demonstrated expertise in QA, with a proven track record driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Extensive proven experience testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Deep knowledge of QA practices in SaaS and multi-tenant software applications.
Solid understanding of IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills, with a strong command of identifying and surfacing issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Strong leadership and collaboration abilities, with the capacity to influence across engineering, product management, field service, and partner teams.

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our team.
The role is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be central to enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. You will regularly connect with engineers, product managers, field service teams, and partners to keep quality efforts aligned across the organisation. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0303.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, actively contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — staying in close contact with engineers across the organisation, product management, field service and partners, and speaking up early when issues arise.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results, and walk stakeholders through findings as needed.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team, coordinating regularly with the team throughout the process.
cond_0303.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field; Advanced degree preferred.
At least 8 years of QA experience driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and Multi-tenant software applications.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Excellent team player, adaptable to an evolving startup environment.
Commitment to [Company name masked]'s mission of energy equality and technological innovation.
cond_0303.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0303.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.

Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.

The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0416.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.
cond_0416.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 8 years of demonstrated expertise driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven track record in testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Deep knowledge of SaaS and multi-tenant software application testing.
Exceptional analytical problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Preferred Requirements
Strong command of IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Exceptional team collaboration skills and strong ability to influence across engineering, product, and field service teams.
cond_0416.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

cond_0588.intro:
We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our team.
The role of a Senior QA Engineer is integral to building and delivering our enterprise technology platform, which forms the backbone of our business. In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0588.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Drive what's important to test and troubleshoot — collaborating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures with support from R&D team.
cond_0588.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.
Around 8 years of QA experience in QA strategy, test execution, and automation, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Working knowledge of SaaS and multi-tenant software applications from a QA perspective.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Background in analytical problem-solving, with the ability to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems — this is a skill that can be developed on the job as well.
A collaborative team player with openness to feedback and willingness to adapt in an evolving environment.

In this role you would lead the quality practices and testing effort for the entire end to end stack of our platform including our hardware products, firmware, mobile apps, and the software platform that connects our installed hardware, connectivity network, and customers. This platform streamlines the marketing, delivery, installation, and maintenance of our energy products globally.
Your work will be pivotal in enabling the quality process around building our products and the adoption of the right QA automation tools and strategy. This position demands a unique combination of technical skill, knowledge in power systems, pragmatic orientation, user-centric thinking, and experience with connected devices.
cond_0637.responsibilities:
Work within Agile development frameworks, contributing to test strategy and execution across all phases of the product and software development lifecycle.
Be hands-on, relying on diagnostics, code/architecture review and lab experimentations to ensure products' reliable and consistent performance.
Have a high degree of ownership over the lab, planning out and building out new test systems as the situation demands.
Determine what is important to test and troubleshoot — coordinating with engineers across the organization, product management, field service and partners on specific issues and priorities.
Test device firmware, integrations with inverters, batteries, and other energy hardware covering a broad range of regression and new feature/integration testing.
Test the platform software including the mobile apps, web applications, and connected telemetry/OTA with devices.
Develop and execute system test plans/cases, maintain clear documentation of test plans, test cases and results.
Define and build manual and automated test fixtures, coordinating with the R&D team for support.
cond_0637.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field.
At least 8 years of QA experience driving QA strategy, test execution, and automation.
Proven experience with testing hardware, firmware, and software in power systems applications.
Strong QA experience in SaaS and multi-tenant software applications.
Demonstrated analytical problem-solving skills, able to identify and surface issues within complex HW/SW systems.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree.
Familiarity with IoT platforms and applications with connected devices.
Ability to work effectively in an evolving startup environment.
